LanguageData.LP_IceDevil.label: ice devil
LanguageData.LP_IceDevil.description: A devil from the depths of the Nine Hells, with frost on its ice-blue carapace, an insectoid head with curved horns and a long tail with ice spikes. Ice devils are summoned by the Red Wizards to fight for Thay: a biting chill radiates from them, slowing approaching enemies more and more; the tail spike freezes the blood when it pierces flesh. Ice devils don't eat or sleep and can't be captured: once they fall they are banished to the Nine Hells, leaving only a tail spike.
LanguageData.LP_IceDevil.descriptionShort: A devil that only appears in the Thayan expedition. Chill aura slows enemies, ice-spiked tail, sees the invisible; banished to the Nine Hells when downed.
LanguageData.LP_Balor.label: balor
LanguageData.LP_Balor.description: One of the most terrible demons of the Abyss: a body two and a half times human size wrapped in flame, with bat wings and a fiery whip. Balors fear no fire; anything standing next to one may catch fire, even Thay's own soldiers; one beat of its wings can knock down the enemies around it. When a balor is struck down its body crumbles and a second later explodes into a ball of fire, leaving only a still-beating heart.
LanguageData.LP_Balor.descriptionShort: A demon that only appears in the Thayan expedition. Body size ×2.5, fire immunity, flame aura, wing buffet knockback, death explosion; fears cold.
